categories.main_business_segments: Gansu Golden Solar Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of high-efficiency heterojunction (HJT) solar cells and photovoltaic modules. The company also produces fireproof glass and steel door/window systems. Its core business focuses on N-type monocrystalline heterojunction solar cells and modules, serving both domestic and international photovoltaic power generation markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in heterojunction (HJT) solar cell technology, which features high conversion efficiency (up to 26%) and cost reduction pathways. Key technological focuses include silicon wafer thinning, silver paste consumption optimization, 0BB (zero busbar) welding technology, copper plating, screen printing, and advanced encapsulation methods. Production follows a 'sales-driven production' model with integrated R&D, procurement, manufacturing, and sales processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include domestic centralized and distributed photovoltaic power station operators, large ground power stations, and overseas clients in Singapore, India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. The company mainly sells solar cells and modules to downstream module manufacturers and power generation enterprises. Major customers include Guangdong Zhongliang Construction Engineering Co., Ltd., accounting for a significant portion of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Gansu Province and production facilities in Suzhou and Jiuquan. It has established overseas subsidiaries and sales offices in Europe (Germany, Netherlands, UK), Dubai, and the Middle East to serve international markets. Domestic sales dominate revenue, with over 95% of sales within China and the remainder primarily in Germany and other overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gansu Golden Solar operates in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic industry chain, focusing on processing upstream silicon wafers into solar cells and assembling these into photovoltaic modules. It procures raw materials such as silicon wafers and silver paste from upstream suppliers and sells finished cells and modules downstream to power station operators and module manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes cost reduction and efficiency improvements through technological innovation in heterojunction solar cells. R&D initiatives include wafer thinning, silver paste optimization, 0BB technology, copper plating, and advanced encapsulation. Despite reduced R&D spending during the pre-restructuring period, the company maintains a clear roadmap for scaling up high-efficiency heterojunction technology and expanding market applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of photovoltaic solar cells and modules. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, targeting both domestic and international markets. Additional revenue streams include sales of fireproof glass and steel door/window products, as well as income from leasing factory properties.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the few capable of large-scale production of heterojunction solar cells in China, holding a first-mover advantage in this technology segment. It faces intense competition due to industry overcapacity and price declines but leverages its technological expertise, scale, and customer relationships to maintain competitiveness in the midstream photovoltaic manufacturing sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported a significant revenue decline of approximately 79% to 123.7 million RMB and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 795 million RMB, reflecting intensified industry competition and operational challenges including bankruptcy restructuring. Total assets stood at approximately 2.7 billion RMB with negative net equity. The company is undergoing pre-restructuring with substantial debt and liquidity pressures but expects operational improvements in 2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gansu Golden Solar emphasizes its advanced heterojunction solar cell technology offering higher conversion efficiency (up to 26%) and lower degradation rates compared to conventional cells. Its products provide about 10% more power generation and 3% lower levelized cost of electricity (LCOE), delivering superior performance and cost-effectiveness. The company’s integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities enable rapid innovation and scale, supporting differentiated, high-quality photovoltaic solutions.
